content: QuPath export via MeasurementExporter: import qupath.lib.gui.tools.MeasurementExporter, import qupath.lib.objects.PathDetectionObject. Build exporter with imageList (project.getImageList()), separator('\t'), exportType (PathDetectionObject), then call exportMeasurements(outputFile). Coordinates are exported in calibrated micron units if pixel calibration is set (which it is from the OME-XML PhysicalSizeX metadata in the MIP OME-TIFF). Run for project (without save) variant works for pure export. BraiAn export script also handles per-region counts via ExportABBACellCountResults.
